sampling.note: remote frontier forecasts are unseeded in effect: parameters are sent only where the gateway lists them as supported, and the seal records which were sent

resolution_rule_text: newest_created: among gateway models matching include and not exclude, the highest created timestamp wins; ties break to the shortest id, then lexicographic. The full candidate list is logged in every seal. A pin overrides the rule and is itself logged.
